dedupe_keys.name: cigre tb 736 power system test cases for emt type simulation studies

description: CIGRE Technical Brochure 736 defines four test cases for electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation of power systems: modified versions of the IEEE 39-bus and IEEE 118-bus benchmarks, a transmission grid called T-Grid and an active distribution network model. Working Group C4.503 published it in 2018 so that results can be compared across EMT software, and it gives full data and sample simulation results. The page states that models are also public in an online repository, whose address was not shown. The brochure is a 148-page PDF of 7 MB; CIGRE members read it free and non-members pay 270 euros, and a free account is needed. Coverage is generic, since the systems are benchmarks, not real networks. Caveats: the paper itself is paid for non-members and the linked model files were not located, and the brochure is dated 2018. It suits network flow and resilience studies that need standard transient benchmarks for software comparison. Related catalogue record: data-cigre-tb575-distribution-benchmark-networks holds CIGRE distribution benchmark networks.
